site.name: Gaur City Char Murti Chowk
site.survey: Greater Noida Authority junction counts at Char Murti (Sector 1), weekday PM peak video classification; island geometry from the imagery
site.summary: Four-arm signalised roundabout: entries are metered by signals rather than pure gap acceptance, so the ring discharges in bands while queues sit on the approaches. Channelised nearside slip lanes bypass the signals - the left-turn streams keep moving while the arms stand still.

imagery.bearing_note: fitted to the Char Murti roundabout

signals.name: Char Murti ring controller
signals.notes: One stage per arm; the circulating carriageway is never held and keeps discharging while an approach is red
